description: Returns every lettered advisory note in a month's Visa Bulletin: the forward-looking text, e.g. "EB-1 India may become unavailable". Use it when the user asks whether dates are expected to advance, hold, or retrogress. For the chart dates themselves, use get_visa_bulletin or get_visa_bulletin_dv. An empty list means the month was loaded and had no notes; a month not on file returns not_found. Free, no sign-in required. Limit: 20 calls per minute per IP, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Source: the Department of State Visa Bulletin (travel.state.gov).

month.description: Bulletin month as YYYY-MM, e.g. "2026-10". A month not yet published or loaded returns not_found
